Final deliverables: `index.html`, `styles.css`, `app.jsx`. Test runner files (`a11y-test.js`, `a11y-full.js`) remain alongside.

**Accessibility test results (final, run on the submitted artifact):**

| Scenario | axe violations |
|---|---|
| Desktop 1280×900 | 0 |
| Tablet 768×1024 | 0 |
| Mobile 360×740 | 0 |
| Interactive (form error, filter, wishlist, add-to-cart) | 0 |

**Issues found and fixed:**
1. **`color-contrast` (serious)** — "Sale" tag was `#fff` on `#ff6b6b` (2.77:1). Changed background to `#b91c1c` for ≥4.5:1 contrast.
2. **`heading-order` (moderate)** — Footer column headings jumped from `<h2>` to `<h4>`. Changed to `<h3>`.

**Known limitations:** axe-core covers ~30–50% of WCAG; manual screen-reader, keyboard-only, and zoom audits were not performed in this environment. Image `alt` text is descriptive for the hero; product imagery uses the product name as alt (accurate but generic).
